parameters.jsCode: const usage={durationMs:Math.max(0,Date.now()-$json.job.startedAt)};if($env.AI_PROVIDER_MODE==='openai'){let input=0,output=0,embedding=0,seenText=false,seenEmbedding=false;for(const name of ['OpenAI classify','OpenAI query embedding','OpenAI draft']){let body;try{body=$(name).first().json.body;}catch{continue;}if(!body?.usage)continue;if(name==='OpenAI query embedding'){if(Number.isInteger(body.usage.total_tokens)){embedding+=body.usage.total_tokens;seenEmbedding=true;}}else if(Number.isInteger(body.usage.input_tokens)&&Number.isInteger(body.usage.output_tokens)){input+=body.usage.input_tokens;output+=body.usage.output_tokens;seenText=true;if(typeof body.model==='string')usage.model=body.model;}}if(seenText){usage.inputTokens=input;usage.outputTokens=output;}if(seenEmbedding)usage.embeddingTokens=embedding;}return [{json:{...$json,usage}}];
